name: Torvalds Reveals the Truth
description: Torvalds speaks plainly, stating that what has been happening is not real—that everything has been an act. His words cut through the pretense, exposing the performance for what it is.
related_events: Torvalds reveals the act

name: Gabriel Shocked During Dog Walk
description: Gabriel steps out of his yard with his dog. As soon as he leaves the property, he is jolted by a sudden electric shock.
related_events: Gabriel gets shocked while dog walking

name: Torvalds Raises His Middle Finger to the Glass
description: Torvalds looks into the glass with a smug expression. He lifts his hand and raises his middle finger.
related_events: Torvalds displays middle finger while looking into the glass

name: Ferrari Modena Arrives at Stanley's Trailer
description: A Ferrari Modena races down a barren road, kicking up a cloud of gravel as it speeds toward Stanley's run-down trailer in the middle of an empty landscape.
related_events: Ferrari Modena speeds toward Stanley's trailer

name: Man Holds Woman on Sidewalk with Weapon
description: On the sidewalk, the suited man stands with an automatic weapon slung across his body. He holds the woman in place, positioning her so that people nearby can see her. Passersby glance over, some slowing down as the man keeps her visible, his presence and the weapon drawing attention.
related_events: Suited man displays her publicly with weapon present

name: Gabriel Makes a Phone Call
description: Gabriel picks up his cell phone and dials a number.
related_events: Gabriel dials a phone number on his cell phone

name: SWAT Team Moves to Bank Roof
description: The SWAT team made their way up to the roof of the bank, moving in formation. They took up positions on the rooftop, scanning the area as they prepared for the next phase of the operation.
related_events: SWAT team advances to the roof of the bank

name: Roberts and Joy React to Alarming News
description: Roberts stops suddenly when he hears something alarming. He and Joy look at each other in silence, their eyes meeting with a shared awareness of the moment.
related_events: Roberts halts upon hearing something alarming
Roberts and Joy exchange a meaningful glance

name: Stanley Shoves Ginger Down the Steps and Slams the Door
description: Stanley grabs Ginger and shoves her down the steps leading from his trailer. She stumbles and falls as he immediately slams the door shut behind her.
related_events: Stanley forcefully pushes Ginger down the trailer steps
Stanley slams the trailer door shut

name: Gabriel Moves Through the Crowd
description: Gabriel walks through a crowd of elegant, beautiful people who part as he approaches. He exchanges kisses with some, lingers in embraces, and brushes hands with others, moving smoothly through the throng. The air hums with attention focused on him, every gesture met with response, every step unhurried. Around him, the crowd shifts like water, making way without question.
related_events: Gabriel moves through a crowd receiving attention

name: Gabriel Exits the Lamborghini
description: A yellow Lamborghini Diablo pulls up. In slow motion, Gabriel steps out of the car. The wind catches the tails of his full-length black Gucci overcoat, whipping them behind him as he moves.
related_events: Gabriel exits Lamborghini Diablo in slow motion

name: Ball Bearings Roll Across Street and Strike Coffee Shop
description: Loose ball bearings roll and bounce across the street, clattering over the pavement before tapping against the exterior of the coffee shop.
related_events: Ball bearings bounce across the street and tap against the coffee shop

name: Pulling the Trigger
description: Satisfied with the placement, he pulls the trigger. The gun fires—THUMP! THUMP! THUMP! THUMP!—four rapid shots echoing in quick succession.
related_events: Character pulls the trigger on a firearm
Firearm discharges four times in rapid succession

name: Roberts and A.D. Joy React to a Sudden Alert
description: Roberts rises to his feet after hearing a sudden sound. At the same moment, A.D. Joy lunges toward his radio in slow motion.
related_events: Roberts stands up after hearing something
A.D. Joy jumps for his radio in slow motion

name: Gabriel Watches the Crowd as Torvalds Leaves
description: Gabriel stands on a lavish balcony, looking down at the crowd below. His expression is calm, a faint smile on his face as he surveys the gathering. From somewhere off-screen, Torvalds speaks, announcing his departure.
related_events: Gabriel observes the crowd from the balcony
Torvalds announces departure

name: Gabriel and Stanley Captured
description: Gabriel stands with a radio-frequency electronic dog collar around her neck. At the same time, Stanley is held firmly by two well-dressed men.
related_events: Gabriel is seen wearing a radiofrequency electronic dog collar
Stanley is restrained by two well-dressed men

name: Torvalds Raises Middle Finger as Laser Targets Throat
description: Torvalds smiles and raises his middle finger. At the same moment, a red aiming laser passes through a glass surface and settles as a small dot on his throat.
related_events: Torvalds raises middle finger while smiling
Red aiming laser targets Torvalds' throat through glass

name: Bad Agent #2 Aims at Torvalds' Tonsils and Partially Pulls Trigger
description: Bad Agent #2 points his gun directly at Torvalds' tonsils and slowly squeezes the trigger, stopping partway.
related_events: Bad Agent #2 aims gun at Torvalds' tonsils
Bad Agent #2 partially pulls trigger of his gun

name: Gabriel Confronts Mercenary Holding Weeping Girl as Snipers Target the Merc
description: Gabriel points his weapon at the mercenary, who holds up a weeping girl in front of him for all to see. Red laser dots flicker to life on the mercenary's chest, steady and bright against his clothes.
related_events: Gabriel aims weapon at mercenary holding hostage
Mercenary displays weeping girl as human shield
Laser targeting dots appear on mercenary's chest

name: Ginger Comments on Stan's Apartment and Takes a Beer
description: Stan ignores Ginger and walks into his bedroom. She walks over to the fridge, opens it, and pulls out a beer. As she does, she says, "This is not a nice place you have here, Stanley." She continues, "I've only been here a few minutes and I'm already starting to feel sorry for myself."
related_events: Stan ignores Ginger and walks into his bedroom
Ginger comments on the state of Stan's living space
Ginger opens the fridge and retrieves a beer

name: SWAT Team Engages Mercenary and Rescues Hostage
description: The SWAT snipers open fire on the mercenary after he makes a sudden movement with his weapon. Bullets strike him, and he collapses to the ground. An armored SWAT vehicle speeds into the area and comes to a stop. A team member jumps out and rushes forward to rescue the woman.
related_events: SWAT snipers open fire on mercenary due to perceived aggressive weapon movement
Mercenary collapses after being shot by SWAT snipers
SWAT armored vehicle arrives at scene for rescue operation
SWAT team member exits armored vehicle to rescue woman

name: SWAT Team Moves Into Position as Mercenary Turns
description: SWAT team members take up positions around the perimeter. The mercenary turns toward them, his weapon shouldered. The motion carries the weapon upward in slow motion.
related_events: SWAT members take up positions around the perimeter
Mercenary turns toward SWAT team with weapon shouldered
Weapon swings upward due to momentum in slow motion

name: Arrest of Axl Torvalds on Pedestrian Walkway
description: Axl Torvalds steps out of the elevator and walks steadily toward the pedestrian walkway. Midway across, security teams emerge from both ends, moving quickly to surround him. They tackle him to the ground. One agent flips open a badge and holds it close to his face. 'Axl Torvalds. You are under arrest.'
related_events: Torvalds exits elevator and walks toward pedestrian walkway
Security teams converge on Torvalds on pedestrian walkway
Torvalds is wrestled to the ground by security teams
Security agent flashes badge and places Torvalds under arrest

name: Melissa Answers Stanley's Call
description: A telephone rings inside a Malibu beach house. Melissa, a woman in her late twenties, picks up the receiver and says, 'Hello.' A man's voice, Stanley, asks, 'Melissa... Holly home?' Melissa responds, 'Stanley. Why are you calling here?' As she speaks, her voice shifts slightly, revealing traces of a New York accent.
related_events: Telephone rings in Malibu beach house
Melissa answers the telephone call
Stanley asks if Holly is home
Melissa confronts Stanley about calling the house

name: Torvalds Faces the Mirror, Gun Aimed from the Other Side
description: Torvalds speaks with his attorney in Finnish before walking over to the one-way mirror. He leans closer to the glass, his reflection staring back. On the other side, Bad Agent #2 screws a silencer onto a .45 caliber pistol. Once it's in place, he presses the barrel against the mirror directly in line with Torvalds' face. He slowly drags the gun down, tracing the outline of Torvalds' reflection from head to neck.
related_events: Torvalds converses with his attorney in Finnish
Torvalds approaches the one-way mirror
Bad Agent #2 attaches silencer to .45 caliber gun
Bad Agent #2 aims silenced gun at Torvalds through mirror
Bad Agent #2 moves gun barrel across Torvalds' reflection

name: Roberts Confronts Torvalds' Attorney in the Hallway
description: Roberts walks out of the room and comes face to face with Torvalds' attorney in the hallway. The attorney begins to speak, saying, 'You will be hearing from my gover --' but Roberts cuts him off, saying, 'Shut up.' Roberts continues down the hall. The attorney, visibly angered, turns and walks back into the interrogation room.
related_events: Roberts exits the room abruptly
Attorney confronts Roberts with a legal warning
Roberts silences the attorney

name: Roberts Leaves, Attorney Returns
description: Roberts walks down the hallway. The attorney, visibly angry, turns and goes back into the interrogation room.
related_events: Roberts walks down the hallway
Attorney returns to interrogation room in anger

name: Agents Watch Interrogation as Torvalds Begins to Talk
description: Two FBI agents stand on the other side of a two-way mirror, watching an interrogation in progress. Inside the room, Torvalds speaks over the speaker, saying he will tell what he knows. The agents exchange glances. One of them, Bad Agent #1, studies his partner closely, noting a striking resemblance to a mercenary seen carrying a young blonde girl before a shooting outside a bank. Without a word, Bad Agent #1 pulls out a cell phone and dials. He speaks into the phone, asking for Assistant Director Joy and requesting that Agent Roberts be found immediately.
related_events: FBI agents observe interrogation through two-way mirror
Torvalds offers information during interrogation
Bad Agent #1 recognizes resemblance to Gabriel's mercenary

name: Bad Agent #1 Calls Assistant Director Joy
description: Two FBI agents watch the interrogation through a two-way mirror. One of them, Bad Agent #1, notices something unsettling—the other agent bears a strong resemblance to the mercenary who carried the young blonde girl killed outside the bank. Without delay, Bad Agent #1 dials his cell phone. He speaks into the receiver: 'Yes, this is Assistant Director Joy, would you find Agent Roberts. It's important that I speak with him as soon as possible. Thank you.'
related_events: Bad Agent #1 makes urgent phone call to Assistant Director Joy

name: Stanley and Ginger Arrive at LAX
description: Stanley and Ginger walk out of the LAX terminal into the arrival area. A Boeing 777 passes overhead, its engines roaring. A white limousine idles in the pickup zone directly ahead. Stanley wears a black T-shirt with the word 'LOSER' printed in large white letters across the front, clearly visible as he moves toward the car.
related_events: Stanley and Ginger exit LAX terminal
Boeing 777 flies overhead at LAX
White limousine idles at LAX pickup zone
Stanley displays 'LOSER' shirt upon arrival

name: Torvalds Meets Representative and Completes Job
description: Torvalds flies to his destination to meet an associate. The associate sends one of his people to greet him upon arrival. Torvalds receives instructions on what is needed. He carries out the task and is paid for the work.
related_events: Torvalds travels to meet an associate
Associate sends representative to meet Torvalds
Torvalds receives job instructions and completes assignment

name: Gabriel and His Men Take Control of the Bank
description: Gabriel turns away from the window and walks deeper into the bank. Inside, three Hummers and a bright red Ferrari F50 are parked across the floor, surrounded by broken glass. All but one of the front windows have been sealed shut with thick steel plates. Over two dozen hostages lie face down on the ground, their arms bound behind their backs with cable ties. Duct tape is wrapped around their chests, and each wears a dog collar. Nine armed men move through the space, dressed in suits that resemble high-end fashion, though their automatic weapons break the illusion. One of them, Marco, finishes fastening a collar around the neck of a young blonde woman whose face is streaked with mascara. She whimpers as he signals completion. Gabriel nods. 'Take her out.' The front door opens, and one of the armed men drags the woman outside. She sobs uncontrollably, barely able to stand, her body shaking as she is pulled away from the building.
related_events: Armed men occupy the bank with luxury vehicles inside
Hostages are restrained on the bank floor with cable ties and duct tape

name: Gabriel Orders Collared Hostage Removed
description: An armed man finishes fastening a dog collar around the neck of a young woman who is crying, her face streaked with mascara. She whimpers as he steps back. Gabriel asks, 'How we doin'? The armed man replies, 'Done.' Gabriel says, 'Good. Take her out.' Another armed man grabs the woman by the arm and drags her toward the front door. She stumbles, sobbing heavily, unable to walk on her own. The door opens and he pulls her out onto the street as she continues to cry.
related_events: Armed man places dog collar on a distressed young woman
Distressed young woman is dragged out of the bank by an armed man

name: Hostage Resists Rescue Amid Bank Standoff
description: The hostage, screaming and frantic, bolts back toward the bank. The SWAT officer lunges to reach her, but she fights him, thrashing and pulling away. He tightens his grip, hoisting her onto his shoulder as she kicks and wails, still shouting toward the bank for help. Her cries echo in the street as he carries her forward, struggling to maintain control.
related_events: Hostage runs back toward the bank in panic
SWAT officer grabs and carries struggling hostage
Hostage screams for help while being carried away

name: The Step That Triggered the Explosion
description: The SWAT officer stepped off the sidewalk. As he did, the radio dog collar around the hostage's neck blinked from green to red. A sharp beep sounded. Then the explosion ripped through the air, hurling ball bearings that slammed into the bank's steel plating and ricocheted in all directions.
related_events: SWAT officer steps off the sidewalk triggering explosion
Radio dog collar activates and detonates explosive
Explosion sends ball bearings ricocheting off bank's steel plating

name: Roberts Confronts Torvalds in Interrogation
description: Roberts tells Torvalds the story he’s given is no good, his tone laced with sarcasm. Torvalds responds by smiling at him, calm and arrogant. The tension between them tightens as the door opens and an FBI agent appears, announcing a call from Assistant Director Joy. Roberts mutters that at least it’s not his wife, then tells Torvalds to think harder about what else he might know. He orders the agent to watch Torvalds before leaving the room. The agent steps outside, taking position by the door.
related_events: Roberts dismisses Torvalds's story as insufficient
Torvalds smiles arrogantly at Roberts

name: FBI Agent Interrupts Interrogation with Urgent Call
description: Roberts is speaking with Torvalds when the door opens and an FBI Agent appears. The Agent tells Roberts he has a call. Roberts tells him to take a message, but the Agent says it's from Assistant Director Joy and that it's important. Roberts mutters that at least it's not his wife, then tells Torvalds to think about what else he knows. He leaves the room, and the Agent takes up position outside the door, leaving Torvalds alone.
related_events: FBI Agent interrupts interrogation to deliver phone call message

name: Roberts Reasserts Control Before Leaving
description: Roberts tells Torvalds to think about what else he knows. He orders the FBI agent to watch Torvalds, then walks out of the room. The agent takes position outside the door.
related_events: Roberts instructs Torvalds to reconsider what he knows
Roberts leaves interrogation room after receiving call notification

name: Agent Takes Post Outside Interrogation Room
description: After Roberts leaves the room, the FBI Agent moves to stand outside the door, keeping watch over Torvalds as the interrogation pauses.
related_events: FBI Agent takes position outside interrogation room door

name: Axl Torvalds Undergoes Customs Inspection
description: Axl Torvalds enters the customs area. Agents begin inspecting his luggage, unpacking the contents of his bags. They find three laptops and handle them with suspicion. One agent cuts short Torvalds' request to be careful. He mutters under his breath about the equipment being expensive. The agents then discover a second passport among his belongings. One of them takes both passports and calls Torvalds over. He checks his watch—it reads 1:45 PM—and asks how long he will be delayed. The official assures him it will only take a moment. Torvalds steps aside while the two agents examine the passports and enter information into a computer terminal. By 1:50 PM, they are still comparing the documents when Torvalds notices a customs employee pushing a cart of confiscated items out of a nearby service elevator. The agents continue their discussion, momentarily distracted. Torvalds picks up his computer case and walks toward the elevator. He steps inside just as the doors close. The agents look around and realize he is gone. One of them glances up and sees the elevator numbers changing above the door.
related_events: Axl Torvalds enters customs and undergoes baggage inspection
Customs agents discover and examine two passports belonging to Axl Torvalds
Customs officials compare Axl Torvalds' passports and input data into a terminal
Axl Torvalds expresses concern about being delayed during customs processing

name: Torvalds Takes the Elevator
description: A customs employee wheeled a cart of confiscated items out of a service elevator. Axl Torvalds, standing nearby, glanced back at the two customs officials who were still discussing his passports. He picked up his computer case, walked over to the elevator, and stepped inside just as the doors closed. The officials continued their conversation until one of them looked around and realized Torvalds was no longer there. Another noticed the elevator indicator above the door showing that the car was moving.
related_events: Customs employee removes confiscated items from service elevator on a cart
Axl Torvalds glances back at the customs officials discussing his case
Axl Torvalds picks up his computer case and walks to the elevator
Axl Torvalds enters the elevator as the doors close
Customs officials realize Axl Torvalds has disappeared
One customs official notices the elevator indicator changing

name: Stan Dresses and Prepares to Leave
description: Stan walks into his apartment and begins looking through his clothes for something semi-clean. He pulls on his pants and starts putting on his shoes. As he dresses, he says, "You're wasting your time. I even touch a computer, I go straight to Leavenworth, do not pass go, do not collect 200 dollars," then stops without finishing the thought.
related_events: Stan searches for semi-clean clothes in his apartment
Stanley puts on his pants and shoes
Stanley warns about consequences of using a computer

name: Ginger Squats Before Stanley and Mentions M.I.T.
description: Ginger squats down in front of Stanley, resting her hand on his leg. She tells him they still teach his techniques at M.I.T., then takes a long drink of her beer. Stanley looks at her without responding.
related_events: Ginger squats in front of Stanley and places her hand on his leg
Ginger reminds Stanley of his legacy at M.I.T.

name: Ginger Asks About Holly
description: Ginger squats in front of Stanley as he puts on his shoes. She rests her hand on his leg and tells him they still teach his techniques at M.I.T., smiling before taking a drink of her beer. Stanley looks at her without speaking. She tells him she’s not there to appease him and asks if he’s spoken to Holly. He doesn’t answer, just stares at her.
related_events: Ginger confronts Stanley about his avoidance and mentions Holly
Stan stares at Ginger in contemplation

name: Gabriel Crosses Amid Chaos
description: As Gabriel steps into the street, the silence shatters with the sudden roar of helicopters and the wail of sirens. The sky fills with churning blades as L.A. County PD vehicles swarm the block, sealing off both ends of the road. SWAT trucks screech to a halt alongside news vans, their crews spilling out with cameras rolling. On rooftops, snipers take position, and sharpshooters lean from windows, all weapons trained on Gabriel. He walks forward, unhurried, passing under a 'WORLD BANC' sign beside a hulking armored bus. Stanley follows slowly behind. Gabriel reaches the far sidewalk, moves alongside the bus, and disappears through the glass entrance of the building as the door swings shut.
related_events: Helicopters and sirens abruptly blare as Gabriel crosses the street
Law enforcement and media converge on the street in chaos

name: Gabriel Walks Through the Blockade
description: Gabriel puts on a pair of small sunglasses and steps onto the street. Helicopters thud overhead, sirens wail, and the road is packed with police cars, SWAT trucks, and news vans. Officers and sharpshooters line the rooftops and windows, weapons trained on him. Unfazed, Gabriel walks forward, passing between squad cars and through the crowd of onlookers. He reaches the far sidewalk, moves alongside a large armored bus, and continues under a 'WORLD BANC' sign. He steps through the glass doors of the building, which close behind him.
related_events: Gabriel puts on sunglasses before crossing the street
Gabriel walks calmly through a heavily armed police and media blockade
Gabriel walks beside a heavily armored bus under a 'WORLD BANC' sign

name: Stanley Follows Gabriel Across the Street
description: Gabriel steps off the curb and walks across the street, pausing briefly under a 'WORLD BANC' sign before disappearing through a glass front door. Moments later, Stanley steps off the same curb, crossing the street in Gabriel's wake. The sound of helicopters and sirens fills the air as SWAT teams, police vehicles, and news vans surround the area, weapons trained on the building ahead.
related_events: Stanley follows Gabriel into the street

name: Gabriel Enters the Building
description: Gabriel steps past the armored bus, walks beneath the large 'WORLD BANC' sign, and moves through the glass front door of the building. The door shuts abruptly behind him, closing off the entrance.
related_events: Gabriel enters a building through a glass front door that closes abruptly

name: Ginger Delivers Money and a Warning to Stanley
description: Ginger sits on the hood of her car outside Stanley's trailer, smoking and petting his dog. Stanley steps down from the trailer and asks what she is doing there. He calls his dog 'Judas' when it leans against her. Ginger greets him with a smile, and he returns it, though tensely. She tells him to cut through the bullshit and warns that if he wants any chance of getting his daughter back, he needs to listen. She suggests his daughter could end up working in adult films for her new guardian. Stanley retorts that she shouldn't project her own past onto his child. Ginger points out that his custody case has been dismissed six times over twenty months. She blows smoke at him, then pulls out a large manila envelope. She dumps rubber-banded stacks of hundred-dollar bills onto the ground. She asks how much it would cost to hire the best family lawyer and win custody. Stanley says it would take a lot. Ginger tells him the money is just a start, and all he has to do is meet someone once. If he doesn’t like it, he can walk away. She says he gets to keep the money either way. She puts out her cigarette. They look at each other in silence. She smiles.
related_events: Ginger arrives at Stanley's trailer and waits on her car hood
Ginger confronts Stanley about his daughter's custody

name: Ginger Offers Stanley Money for a Lawyer
description: Ginger sits on the hood of her car, smoking and petting Stanley's dog as he walks out of his trailer. Stanley greets her with suspicion, calling his dog a traitor for leaning against her. Ginger responds with a calm smile and tells him to stop wasting time. She brings up his daughter and the failed custody hearings, listing each court appearance and dismissal over the past twenty months. She warns him that if he doesn’t act, his daughter will end up working in adult films for her new stepfather. Stanley retorts that she shouldn’t project her past onto his child. Ginger ignores the comment and asks how much it would cost to hire the best family lawyer and go to trial. Stanley replies that it would take a lot of money. Without a word, Ginger pulls a large manila envelope from her bag, opens it, and dumps rubber-banded stacks of hundred-dollar bills onto the ground. Stanley stares at the money, then at her. She tells him to meet the lawyer just once—no obligation. If he doesn’t like it, he can walk away. The money is his to keep either way. She crushes her cigarette underfoot. They stand in silence, looking at each other, until she smiles.
related_events: Ginger offers Stanley a large sum of cash to meet with a lawyer about his daughter's custody
Stanley reacts to Ginger's offer of money and proposal to meet a lawyer

name: Ginger Offers Stanley a Risk-Free Meeting
description: Ginger tells Stanley he has nothing to lose by meeting the lawyer, just one time. She says he can walk away if he doesn’t like what he sees, and he gets to keep the money either way. She takes a drag from her cigarette, holds the smoke, then slowly releases it into the air. The dog shifts beside her. She waits, watching him, and then presses the cigarette into the dirt until it goes out. They stand in silence, the stacks of cash still scattered at their feet, the weight of the offer hanging between them.
related_events: Ginger emphasizes that Stanley has nothing to lose by meeting the lawyer
Ginger smokes and extinguishes her cigarette while waiting for Stanley's response

name: Stanley Calls His Dog Judas
description: Stanley walks down the steps of his trailer and sees Ginger sitting on the hood of her car, smoking and petting his dog. The dog leans against her, clearly enjoying her attention. Stanley looks at the dog and says, 'Judas,' his tone tinged with mock indignation. He then turns to Ginger, who smiles at him, and responds with a guarded smile of his own.
related_events: Stanley expresses frustration toward his dog for showing affection to Ginger

name: Joy Authorizes SWAT to Engage
description: Assistant Director Bill Joy stands inside a Starbucks converted into a command center, surrounded by federal and state officers moving quickly between stations. The phone rings, and Joy takes the call. He asks the SWAT leader if the team is ready. The leader responds that they are almost in position. Joy instructs him to take the suspect at the first opportunity. The SWAT leader speaks into his radio, relaying the order to snipers on high ground one and two: they have a green light.
related_events: A.D. Joy authorizes SWAT to engage target
SWAT leader gives green light to snipers on high ground
SWAT leader reports team status to Assistant Director Joy
Assistant Director Bill Joy answers a phone call at a command center
related_occasions: Tactical Command Operation At A Starbucks

name: Roberts Challenges Joy's Tactical Decision at Starbucks Command Center
description: Roberts looks up from a newspaper as federal and state officers move urgently around a Starbucks converted into a command center. The phone rings, and Assistant Director Bill Joy, a man with an unassuming, accountant-like appearance, takes the call. He speaks into the receiver, asking if everyone is in position. The SWAT leader responds that they are almost ready. Joy instructs the team to take the target at the first opportunity and gives a green light to snipers on high ground. Roberts sets the paper down and asks, 'What are you doing?' Joy replies that the FBI does not negotiate with terrorists and assumes Roberts is aware of that policy. As Joy continues on the phone, Roberts picks up a second line. A voice, Gabriel, speaks from the other end, telling them not to talk but to listen, revealing that there are 22 hostages, each bound with 20 pounds of C-4 explosives.
related_events: Roberts questions Assistant Director Joy's actions during an operation
Roberts expresses concern about A.D. Joy's operational decision
A.D. Joy reaffirms FBI policy against negotiating with terrorists
related_occasions: Tactical Command Operation At A Starbucks

name: Roberts Intercepts Gabriel's Hostage Warning
description: Gabriel's voice comes through the phone, delivering a warning: 22 hostages are each wrapped in 20 pounds of C-4 explosives. As Assistant Director Bill Joy holds the call, Roberts, seated nearby, picks up a second phone to listen. Around them, officers move quickly through the transformed Starbucks, now a command post filled with agents and communication equipment. The weight of the threat settles in as Roberts remains on the line, silently absorbing the details.
related_events: Gabriel issues a dire hostage warning during phone call
Roberts listens to phone call by picking up extension
related_occasions: Tactical Command Operation At A Starbucks

name: Ginger Arrives on the Trailer Roof
description: Ginger climbs up the aluminum extension ladder and steps onto the roof of the trailer where Stan stands in a dirty towel, slicing golf balls with little accuracy. She appears calm and composed, lighting a cigarette and telling him her name. She speaks to him directly, revealing personal details about his life, including his mother's maiden name and the size of his bank account. Stan continues hitting golf balls, asking how she got past his dog and what she wants. Ginger responds that she’s not selling anything—that she’s there to help. She takes the golf club from him, tees up a ball, and hits it with precision, sending it flying. After handing the club back, she tells him to straighten his left arm. He follows her advice and hits a ball perfectly, sending it 200 yards into a fridge marked with that distance. Stan looks at the club, drops it, and climbs back down through the hatch into the trailer.
related_events: Ginger climbs onto the trailer roof to meet Stan
Ginger introduces herself and reveals knowledge about Stan

name: Ginger Takes the Club
description: Stan stands on the roof of his trailer, slicing golf balls with a dirty towel wrapped around him. A Rottweiler runs in circles below. As a Ferrari arrives, Stan swings repeatedly, most shots going wide. Ginger climbs up the aluminum ladder and steps onto the roof. She takes the club from him without waiting. She tees up a ball, pulls her skirt up slightly to reveal a thong, and swings. The ball flies off with power and precision, striking the hood of the car with a loud clang. She hands the club back and tells him to straighten his left arm. He tries again, follows her advice, and hits a clean shot that travels 200 yards, slamming into a fridge marked with "200 YARDS." Stan looks at the club, drops it, and climbs down the ladder into the trailer.
related_events: Stan slices golf balls from the roof of his trailer
Ginger takes a golf swing and hits a ball with exceptional skill
Ginger instructs Stan to straighten his left arm during his golf swing

name: Stan Hits the Mark
description: Stan straightens his left arm as Ginger suggested, swings the golf club, and sends a ball flying 200 yards across the yard. It strikes a fridge with the words "200 YARDS" painted on it, producing a sharp clang. He looks at the club, then tosses it to the ground and climbs down the aluminum extension ladder through the hatch on the roof.
related_events: Stan successfully hits a golf ball 200 yards after following Ginger's advice
Stan tosses the golf club to the ground and climbs down the aluminum extension ladder

name: Ginger Arrives to Offer Help
description: Ginger steps onto the roof of Stan's trailer after climbing the aluminum extension ladder. She introduces herself by name and tells Stan she knows details about his life, including his bank account. Stan, standing in a dirty towel and slicing golf balls off the roof, asks how she got past his dog. She replies that boys like her. He asks what she is selling, and she responds that she isn't selling anything—that she is there to help him. She comments on his appearance, saying he's a mess, and tells him that her employer wants to meet him. Stan continues hitting golf balls, missing most of them, until Ginger takes the club, demonstrates a perfect shot, and instructs him to straighten his left arm. He follows her advice and hits a ball perfectly, sending it 200 yards into a fridge marked with that distance. He looks at the club, drops it, and climbs back down the ladder into the trailer.
related_events: Ginger claims she is there to help Stan

name: Stan Hurls Golf Balls at Arriving Ferrari
description: Stan stands on the roof of his rundown trailer, barefoot and wearing only a dirty towel, swinging a golf club at incoming golf balls. A Ferrari drives up the gravel driveway, and Stan begins launching balls toward it. Most miss, flying off in wild directions, but one strikes the car's aluminum hood with a sharp clang, ricocheting away as the vehicle skids to a stop. The driver's door shuts, and footsteps approach as someone climbs the aluminum extension ladder to the roof.
related_events: Stan hits a golf ball that ricochets off the approaching Ferrari's hood

name: Gabriel's Hypothetical Heist Film
description: Three men sit in a window booth at a diner, drinking coffee. Gabriel, a sharply dressed man with a distinct presence, leans forward and begins describing a reimagined version of the film *Dog Day Afternoon*. He suggests what might happen if the robbers started killing hostages without warning, one after another, turning the heist into a relentless bloodbath. He imagines the scene broadcast live in the modern era, with high-powered cameras capturing every detail, the media coverage spreading instantly across the world. He pauses, letting the image settle. Roberts, a man in a polyester suit, shakes his head and says the movie wouldn’t work. Gabriel asks why. Roberts replies that audiences prefer happy endings. Gabriel counters by outlining a version where Pacino’s character escapes with the money, his partner gets a sex change, and they live happily. Stanley, sitting beside Roberts, shakes his head. When Gabriel asks if it’s homophobia, Stanley says no—it’s because the bad guy can’t win. The story has to end with him being brought down. Gabriel glances at his watch, looks around the quiet diner, and says he has to go.

name: Senator Reisman Demands Answers in Emergency Briefing
description: Senator James Reisman strides into a small, windowless boardroom where a meeting is already underway. He glances around, visibly annoyed, and says the meeting had better be important, as he was pulled from an active session. Darwin Kaplan, one of the men present, offers a thin smile and assures him it is. As Reisman begins to sit, Kaplan informs him that Axl Torvalds was intercepted entering the continental United States within the last two hours. He adds that Torvalds was caught during a routine customs check at LAX and was traveling alone. Reisman asks if the authorities realize who they have in custody. Kaplan replies that it is unlikely, explaining that Torvalds panicked during the inspection and has refused to speak English. The Finnish consulate has already contacted the State Department. Reisman presses whether their operation has been compromised. Kaplan says they are not sure but are working to confirm. Reisman warns that someone will face serious consequences if the situation is not under control, making clear it will not be him. Kaplan nods in acknowledgment.

name: Roberts Takes Over the Interrogation
description: Roberts enters the room where FBI agents are questioning Torvalds, who sits with his lawyer at a table littered with empty coffee cups and cigarette remains. The lawyer, dressed in a three-piece suit, sips coffee while Torvalds speaks to him in Finnish. An agent demands to know what was said, but before the lawyer can respond, Roberts steps in, calmly asking the agents to leave. After a brief hesitation, they comply. Roberts sits across from Torvalds, smiles, and makes a cryptic remark about Hamlet being a Dane. He then asks why Torvalds would risk coming to the United States. The lawyer begins to object, but Torvalds speaks again in Finnish, this time saying Roberts' name, prompting laughter from both him and the lawyer. Roberts pushes the lawyer’s coffee cup into his lap, grabs him by the collar, slams him against the wall, and kicks him out the door, tossing his briefcase after him. He locks the door behind him, turns to Torvalds, slaps him across the face, and pins him against the wall, badge in hand. Roberts tells Torvalds about his past as head of a major cyber-crime task force, how he burned out, and shot a suspect in the hand—an accident. Torvalds replies that whatever Roberts can do to him, someone else can do worse, and that his only chance is in Finland, where he has friends. Roberts offers him a deal: information in exchange for a first-class flight home on the U.S. government’s behalf. Torvalds falls silent, considering the offer.
related_events: Roberts interrupts interrogation to speak with Torvalds alone

name: Interrogation Room Standoff
description: Torvalds sits at a table in a dimly lit room, flanked by his lawyer, a sharply dressed man in a three-piece suit sipping coffee. Two FBI agents pace during the interrogation, pressing Torvalds on 24 counts of electronic crimes across seven countries. Torvalds responds in Finnish, speaking quietly to his lawyer. The lead agent demands to know what was said. The lawyer remains silent at first, then explains that Torvalds corrected the agent’s reference to Ikea—pointing out it is Swedish, not Finnish. The agent, irritated, asks if Torvalds understands English. Before the tension escalates further, Roberts enters the room, calm and smiling, and asks the agents to step out. They hesitate but comply. Roberts takes a seat across from Torvalds, who studies his badge and mutters something in Finnish, including the name 'Roberts.' The lawyer chuckles, then translates: Torvalds is a fan of 'The X-Files.' Roberts says nothing, reaches over, and deliberately knocks the lawyer’s coffee into his lap. The lawyer jumps up in pain, cursing, as Roberts grabs him, slams him against the wall, and kicks him out the door, tossing his briefcase after him. He locks the door behind him, turns to Torvalds, and strikes him across the face, shoving him into the wall. Holding up his badge, Roberts tells Torvalds he once led the largest cyber-crime task force in the world but shot a suspect by accident—now he doesn’t care about rules. Torvalds, breathing heavily, says that whatever Roberts can do to him, the people after him can do worse. He’s already a dead man—his only chance is in Finland, where he has allies. Roberts offers a deal: information for a first-class flight home, courtesy of the U.S. government. Torvalds falls silent, considering.

name: Stanley Calls Melissa to Speak with Holly
description: Stanley stands in front of his closed fridge, phone in hand, staring at pictures of his daughter Holly taped to the door. He calls Melissa and asks to speak with Holly, his voice pleading. Melissa refuses, telling him it’s twelve-thirty and Holly is in school. She reminds him that contacting her violates court orders. Stanley argues that it’s not healthy for Holly to be kept from him. Melissa challenges his right to make that claim, bringing up his two-year prison sentence. He uses a familiar nickname, but she snaps at him to stop. His voice softens as he says he just wants to see his baby. Melissa grows angry, warns him not to contact Holly again, and threatens legal action and physical consequences if he does. Stanley responds with a sharp comment about her background, causing a brief silence. She regains her composure, her voice turning cold and steady. She tells him Larry is Holly’s father now and that Stanley has no place in their lives. When Stanley mocks Larry as a porn king, she defends him as a film financier, husband, and businessman. She tells Stanley to get therapy, get a dog, do anything—just stay away from her child. Stanley insists Holly is their child, but Melissa cuts him off, saying he’ll never have the money or legal standing to fight Larry. 'Forget Holly,' she says. The line goes dead with a sharp click. Stanley erupts, slamming the phone receiver against the fridge several times, then stops suddenly. He hangs up the phone with quiet, unsettling calm.
